ns2:section.sectionText: This course requires approval to register by contacting Academic Advisor, Karla Lucht klucht@illinois.edu. Designed to provide each student in the digital image management program of study an opportunity to be involved with the production of digital images; the creation, maintenance and management of digital information databases; intellectual property and copyright issues; the use and management of advanced network and information technologies including web site design and maintenance; and the client markets of libraries, archives, information centers and museums.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Library & Information Science department.
